messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Let me create a fun, simple SVG drawing combining a bicycle with a pelican sitting on it. Let me think about the layout:

Bicycle: two wheels (circles), frame (lines/polygons), handlebars, seat, pedals
Pelican: body, long beak with pouch, wing reaching to handlebars, legs on pedals

I'll make it a bit cartoonish. Canvas maybe 400x300.

Bicycle placement: wheels at (100, 220) and (300, 220), radius 45. Frame: from rear wheel hub to seat tube, top tube, down tube to front hub, head tube, handlebars.

Frame coordinates:
- Rear hub: (100, 220)
- Front hub: (300, 220)
- Bottom bracket (crank): (195, 225)
- Top of seat tube: (175, 150)
- Top of head tube: (270, 140)
- Handlebars: (270, 135) curving back to (250, 130)

Frame lines: rear hub → top of seat tube, top of seat tube → top of head tube (top tube), top of seat tube → bottom bracket, bottom bracket → rear hub (chainstay), bottom bracket → front hub (down tube... actually down tube is bottom bracket → bottom of head tube). Good enough as cartoon.

Wheels with spokes (simplify: circles + a few lines, or just dashed circles). Spokes as lines.

Pelican on seat around (170, 150): body is an ellipse around (150, 120)? Pelican sits above the saddle at (170, 145). Body: ellipse cx=150, cy=110, rx=45, ry=35. Tail on the left. Neck curving up from the front of the body: from (185, 95) to head at (220, 60)? Beak long, pointing right/down toward handlebars, with pouch. Head circle at (215, 55) r=14. Beak: long shape from (225, 55) to (300, 75), pouch bulging downward.

Wing/arm from body to handlebars: path from (185, 110) to (255, 132).

Legs from bottom of body to pedals: two lines from (160,140) to crank (195, 225), with small feet. Pedals: crank circle at (195,225) r=6, crank arms to (180, 210) and (210, 240)? Feet on the pedal positions.

Eye: small circle on the head.

Color scheme: pelican white body with orange beak/pouch, blue frame, black wheels.

Add a ground line, maybe put in motion lines to show speed.

Let me write the SVG carefully.

Wheels: spokes — lines every 45 degrees from the hub. Just draw a few.

Pelican body with webbed feet. Keep it simple.

Full SVG:

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320" width="400" height="320">
  Background optionally a light sky rectangle.
  Ground line at y=270.

  Bike wheels:
  circle cx=100 cy=225 r=45 fill none stroke black stroke-width 5
  inner circle r=38? Spokes as lines.
  same for cx=300.

  Frame stroke #1565c0 stroke-width 6, fill none, lines:
  M100,225 L175,150 L270,145 L195,225 L100,225 (rear triangle-ish)
  M175,150 L195,225 (seat tube... actually 175,150 to bottom bracket 195,225)
  M195,225 L270,145 already covered. down tube: M195,225 L275,150 close to head tube.
  Seat stays: M100,225 L175,150. Chainstay: M100,225 L195,225.

  Saddle: small ellipse/path at (170,145).
  Handlebar: from top of head tube (270,145) up to (270,130), then curve back: path M270,148 L272,128 Q272,120 260,122 L248,126.

  Crank: circle at (195,225) r=8 fill gray; pedal arms line (195,225)-(215,240) and (175,210), pedal small rects.

  Pelican:
  Body: ellipse cx=145 cy=115 rx=48 ry=34 fill white stroke #333.
  Tail: polygon (95,105) (70,95) (95,125).
  Wing: path inside the body, maybe M120,100 Q150,135 175,120 (wing line) or raised wing.
  Neck: path from (180,95) to (210,60), thick stroke white with outline? Simpler: use head circle and neck as a thick stroke path with white stroke width 16 and dark outline. Easier: draw neck as a filled path.

  Simple: white stroke width 16 path M178,100 Q200,80 208,62, then same path dark stroke width 18 underneath for outline. Two-path trick.

  Head: circle cx=212 cy=55 r=14 fill white stroke #333.
  Beak: path M222,50 L305,62 L300,72 L224,66 with pouch: big pouch path M224,60 Q265,95 300,66 L305,62? Let me design: upper mandible line from (222,52) to (305,60). Pouch: path from (224,64) curving down Q(265,92)(302,62). Fill pouch with orange #f4a41f, stroke with darker color.

  Let's make the beak one group:
  upper: path M220,52 L305,62 L302,68 L222,60 Z fill #f4a41f
  pouch: path M222,60 L302,68 Q265,95 226,70 Z fill #f28c28

  Eye: circle cx=214 cy=51 r=2.5 fill black.

  Arm/wing to handlebar: path M175,110 Q215,125 250,126 stroke white width 12, with dark outline underneath width 14. Grip on handlebar.

  Legs: two lines from (155,145) and (165,147) to pedals: front pedal (215,238) and rear pedal (175,212). Draw white stroke width 8, dark width 10 outline. Webbed foot: small triangle at pedal.

  Motion lines behind: lines at y=100, 120, from x=20 to x=60.

Order matters: draw bike frame, then pelican legs behind? Draw legs after frame so feet on top of pedals. Draw pelican body above the saddle.

Also add spokes: lines through hub of the wheel at 0°, 45°, 90°, 135°.

Let me write it out.
answer:

  <!-- Body -->

- 💨 Speed lines suggesting it's cruising along happily
